async def act(page):
    # Scope all queries to the specific product document to avoid ambiguity
    doc = page.get_by_role(
        "document",
        name="Rocco Gym Tank-XS-Blue / Manage Products / Catalog / Magento Admin",
    )

    # Scope the Inventory group and the Stock Availability combobox within it
    inventory_group = doc.get_by_role("group", name="Inventory")
    stock_combo = inventory_group.get_by_role("combobox", name="Stock Availability")

    # Wait for the combobox to be visible, then select "Out of Stock"
    await stock_combo.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=15000)
    await stock_combo.focus()
    await stock_combo.select_option({"label": "Out of Stock"})

    # Small pause to ensure the UI registers the change
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # Click the Save button scoped under the same document (this may navigate away)
    save_btn = doc.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    await save_btn.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=15000)
    await save_btn.click(timeout=30000)
